responsibility: Declares the HTML diagnostics output backend and its configuration surface. It defines html_generation_options for CSS, JavaScript, and state-diagram controls, and exposes the entry points for opening HTML output files, constructing an HTML sink, and printing diagnostic paths as HTML, serving as the public interface to the XHTML-generating implementation in html-sink.cc.
same_name_distinction: This is the public interface half of the HTML sink pair: it declares html_generation_options and the exported open/make/print APIs, while html-sink.cc provides the concrete sink, XML-building logic, output-file handling, and tests.
